# New-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a discovery rule prototype.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype [[-Name] <string>] [[-Type] <ZabbixItemType>] [-HostId <ulong>] [-Uuid <string>] [-RuleId <ulong>] [-Key <string>] [-LifetimeType <ZabbixLowLevelDiscoveryLifetimeType>] [-Lifetime <string>] [-EnabledLifetimeType <ZabbixLowLevelDiscoveryEnabledLifetimeType>] [-EnabledLifetime <string>] [-Description <string>] [-Status <ZabbixItemStatus>] [-Discover <ZabbixItemDiscoverMode>] [-Preprocessing <ZabbixPreprocessingStepRequest[]>] [-LowLevelDiscoveryMacroPath <ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototypeLowLevelDiscoveryMacroPathRequest[]>] [-Filter <ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototypeFilterRequest>] [-Override <ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototypeOverrideRequest[]>] [-Parameter <ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototypeParameterRequest[]>] [-TypeParameters <string>] [-Timeout <string>] [-Delay <string>] [-UserName <string>] [-Password <SecureString>] [-MasterItemId <ulong>] [-InterfaceId <ulong>] [-Url <string>] [-QueryField <ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototypeQueryFieldRequest[]>] [-RequestMethod <ZabbixHttpRequestMethod>] [-PostType <ZabbixItemPostType>] [-Posts <string>] [-Header <ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototypeHeaderRequest[]>] [-StatusCodes <string>] [-FollowRedirects <bool>] [-RetrieveMode <ZabbixHttpTestRetrieveMode>] [-OutputFormat <ZabbixItemHttpOutputFormat>] [-HttpProxy <string>] [-AuthenticationType <int>] [-VerifyPeer <bool>] [-VerifyHost <bool>] [-SslCertificateFile <string>] [-SslKeyFile <string>] [-SslKeyPassword <SecureString>] [-AllowTraps <bool>] [-TrapperHosts <string>] [-IpmiSensor <string>] [-JmxEndpoint <string>] [-SnmpOid <string>] [-PublicKey <string>] [-PrivateKey <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A discovery rule prototype is a discovery rule that a parent discovery rule creates for each entity it finds, for nested discovery (Zabbix 7.4 and later). The New-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype cmdlet sends discoveryruleprototype.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new discovery rule prototype back with discoveryruleprototype.get and writes it. The server requires -RuleId, -Name, -Type and -Key; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. A host or template piped from Get-ZbxHost or Get-ZbxTemplate binds -HostId, so one command creates a discovery rule prototype on each. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a discovery rule prototype

```powershell
$rule = Get-ZbxDiscoveryRule -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Database instances'
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01' | New-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype -Name 'Databases on {#INSTANCE}' -RuleId $rule.ItemId -Key 'db.discovery[{#INSTANCE}]' -Type ZabbixActive -Delay '1h'
```

Creates a discovery rule prototype named Databases on {#INSTANCE} on the host web-01. The command writes the new discovery rule prototype, read back from the server.

- `ZabbixItemPostType`: Bound to -PostType (ByPropertyName). The item post type values: ZBX_POSTTYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototypeHeaderRequest[]`: Bound to -Header (ByPropertyName). headers of a ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototypeCreateRequest.
- `bool`: Bound to -FollowRedirects (ByPropertyName), -VerifyPeer (ByPropertyName), -VerifyHost (ByPropertyName), -AllowTraps (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixHttpTestRetrieveMode`: Bound to -RetrieveMode (ByPropertyName). The HTTP test retrieve mode values: HTTPTEST_STEP_RETRIEVE_MODE_* in defines.inc.php.
